pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with smooth, low-contrast pixel gradients at the edges. Patch spatial area is highest on the upper neck and mid-flank, with noticeable reduction in area and increased fragmentation toward the ventral and lower posterior sections.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous, interconnected lattice. The topological graph is characterized by distinct tri-radial and quad-radial junction nodes. Corridor thickness is relatively uniform across the primary flank area, maintaining clear separation between contiguous dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper cervical line, transitioning to a more compressed, lower-profile contour as it approaches the shoulder region.
